text:
oliver: Heads-up: trying to cut sdk-js for the sample app but regendiff is blocking the publish. It lists a minor bump because generated example objects changed key order only.

mei: can you paste the regendiff snippet?

oliver: paste:```diff
-  examples:
-    - value: {
-        "role": "system",
-        "content": "init"
-      }
+  examples:
+    - value: {
+        "content": "init",
+        "role": "system"
+      }
```No interface/type changes, just key order.

regendiff-bot: Automated: regen diff found in packages/sdk-js/src/generated/ChatExamples.ts. Classified as docs/examples; semver-impact lens: minor due to file diff.

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #1193 failed at regendiff gate. `semver-check: candidate minor bump detected`.

mei: we've seen this before after typegen switched to stable alphabetical stringify. Options: (1) emergency manual override by release-ops, (2) quick dev-tools tweak to canonicalize example objects during comparison, (3) postgen shim to restore previous ordering. Which is fastest?

oliver: release-ops, can you approve an override?

release-ops: I can approve but need PR/description to justify. Short-term I can flip the override if someone pushes a tiny PR documenting examples-only ordering.

mei: I'll open a micro-PR in dev-tools to canonicalize example values when computing regendiff. Also adding a comment marker `// regendiff: ignore-example-order` for generated files.

oliver: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/278  adds canonicalizer and test coverage. I added a note in the PR body explaining rationale.

regendiff-bot: Noted: new commit applied. Re-running regendiff...

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #1194 re-run passed regendiff step. No semver bump detected.

oliver: proceeding with `yarn lerna publish from-package --yes` now. Thanks :tada:

mei: follow-ups: (1) add item to release playbook: "example-only ordering changes are ignored by regendiff", (2) audit other generators for similar churn, (3) coordinate typegen stringify behavior with dev-tools.

release-ops: Approved override logged in release UI. Publish completed.

oliver: closing thread; publish succeeded. Will watch for any sdk parity fallout. :shipit:
